title: MonsteraSpec
description: Canonical MONSTERA specification (monstera.spec.json). The single source of truth for one generated project.

specVersion.description: Specification format version. The engine supports exactly 5 (v4 added the presentation fields kinds[].glyph, kinds[].effect, game.hud and game.screens; v5 adds game.atlas and kinds[].sprite; migrations in docs/SPEC-V2-MIGRATION.md).
